messages:
ben: quick q — where's the dashboard that shows GPU SM% + KV cache hitrate by model? saw a spike + an alert overnight, trying to triage. any quick links or owners to ping?

maria: here's the grafana view: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal/d/gpu-overview?panelId=7&var-cluster=prod — panel 'SM% & KV hitrate by model'. use the top left var `model` to filter per-model.

alex: heads-up: the alert is owned by eng-runtime-oncall (pager duty). usually look at these panels in order: `gpu_sm_util`, `gpu_mem_util`, `kvcache_hitrate`, `batch_size_hist`.

priya: if you want logs for the specific host, check Loki: https://loki.redwood-inference.internal/explore?orgId=1 with query `{job="serving"} | json | model="<model_name>"` — replace model.

ben: thx. the alert message showed SM% > 92% for 6m and a bunch of KV evictions. wondering if we should relax the alert or tune batch sizing. current alert is pretty chatty.

maria: agreed — current rule fires on 90% for 2m. i think we should move to 92% for 5m or add an additional condition for `kvcache_evictions > 100`. pinged infra in #alerts earlier.

alex: i'm +1 for adding evictions condition. often it's transient when autoscaler does pack/unpack. also cheaper to add `for: 5m` than lower threshold.

priya: opened a draft PR to change rule: https://github.com/redwood/alerts/pull/6123 — includes YAML change. snippet below:

```yaml
- alert: HighGPU_SM_Util
  expr: avg_over_time(gpu_sm_util[5m]) > 0.92
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/gpu-sm-util

- alert: GPU_SM_With_KV_Evictions
  expr: avg_over_time(gpu_sm_util[5m]) > 0.90 and increase(kvcache_evictions[5m]) > 100
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
```

ben: perfect. who's the reviewer for that repo? want this in before tomorrow's dev sprint.

maria: @alex usually reviews alert PRs. alex — can you take a look?

alex: will review today. small request: add a note to the playbook to check `batch_size_hist` percentiles (p50/p95) when this fires.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Alert rule update PR 6123 created by priya — CI checks queued.

ben: one more Q — where are the per-model KV cache heatmaps? want to see which models are killing the cache.

maria: panel id 42 in same dashboard has the heatmap. direct link: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal/d/gpu-overview?panelId=42&var-cluster=prod. you can set `var_time=1h` to view last hour.

ben: got it. will triage and report back with model names. thanks all :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — if you find a model with unusually high batch_size variance call it out here and we'll coordinate a canary config change.

priya: noted — i'll follow up in the PR with playbook steps and sample queries for Loki + Grafana.

ben: logging follow-up — for the Loki query you can run: `loki-query "{job=\"serving\", model=\"<model>\"} | json | line_format \"%{_time} %{level} %{msg}\""` to get structured lines.

maria: closing loop — if anyone needs dashboard panels embedded in a doc, DM me and i'll drop the iframe snippets.

ben: tagging this thread resolved for now, will reopen if i see more alerts.
